title: Dismantling the Roadless Rule threatens to disrupt wildlife and water in US
summary: Lands free of roads are under threat from the Trump administration’s proposed rollback.
llm_summary: The Trump administration’s plan to repeal the 2001 “Roadless Rule”—which bans new roads and logging on millions of acres of untouched forest—could fragment habitats, threaten species that rely on road‑free corridors, and increase erosion that degrades water quality.
